_why: RUN TO COMPLETION 2026-08-15: 5 of 5 caught, in two invocations --
`--only I1,I2,I3` then `--only I4,I5`.
Parked as `.unverified` by its author because six pytest invocations in
one command exceeded the per-call ceiling; this suite is the slowest in
the project because it shells out to check_documented_counts.py, which
collects the whole test suite. A concurrent agent added `--only` for
exactly this, un-parked adr-0062 with it, and left a note saying the
same approach should un-park this one. It did.
ADR 0078's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
ADR 0075 named Business/ as ungreppable because .pptx and .docx are
not text. They are zips of XML; it took ten lines of standard library.
The deck claimed '382 automated tests passing' on two slides while the
repository had 1,852 -- the third stale count found that week and the
third that UNDERSTATED.
I3 is the row that escaped. Widening the CONFIGURED tolerance to 99.0 --
under which a claim of 5 tests passes against a suite of 1,852 -- was
invisible to all ten tests, because the tolerance test injects its own
value with monkeypatch. A test that supplies its own configuration
cannot check the configuration that ships.
The original run of this table also exceeded the tool timeout partway
through and LEFT a mutation applied; it was found on the next check and
restored from a cmp-verified backup. That is the failure this harness
exists to make impossible, and it is the strongest argument for the set
file over a hand-run loop.
Run:  python3 scripts/mutate.py --set docs/mutations/adr-0078-investor-claims.json
(or in parts with --only, if your shell has a time limit)

mutations._note: A zip parser that silently returns "" makes this guard report a clean deck it never opened.

mutations.description: a mismatch is computed but never reported
mutations._note: Everything is read, the numbers are compared, nothing is said.

mutations.description: the configured tolerance is widened to 99.0
mutations._claimed: 1 failed (NOT caught before the shipped tolerance was checked)
mutations._note: A tolerance is a threshold, and a large enough threshold is an off switch. Anchored on the full claim line: the bare tolerance literal appears three times, and the harness requires exactly one match -- a find-string that hits several places would patch an arbitrary one of them.

mutations.description: the timestamp window widens until one date excuses the whole document
mutations._note: A number that says when it was true ages honestly -- but a window of 100,000 characters means one 'as of' anywhere in a file excuses every number in it. An off switch wearing a qualifier.
The exemption that distinguishes a dated claim from a stale one must not become an exemption for everything.
